results.title: Theorem 1：重构全部掩码输出
assumptions: $N$有限；固定同一输入、模型和输入基线。

definitions.body_md:
固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$ 与输入基线向量 $r$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留原坐标、在其余坐标使用同一个 $r$。模型是 $v:X\to\mathbb R$，集合函数是 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线是 $b=g(\varnothing)$。本文原始交互为
\[
w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U).
\]
所有子集求和包括空集。特别地 $w_\varnothing=b$。若改用 $g_0=g-b$，只有空集交互改为零；本篇的原始输出没有零基线假设。

results.original_statement_md: 正式来源：正文 PDF 第3页 Theorem 1/Eq.(3)；补充 PDF 第2页 C/Eq.(2)。固定输入 $x$，取 $\Omega=2^N$，每个因果效应为 $w_A=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}v(x_U)$。作者主张 $\forall S\subseteq N,\ Y(x_S)=v(x_S)$；补充材料另主张 Harsanyi dividend 是满足该忠实性要求的唯一度量。
results.original_proof_md:
以下转录补充第3页完整证明数学内容（作者把两部分称为 necessity 与 sufficiency）。由正文SCM，$Y(x_S)=\sum_{A\in\Omega}w_A C_A(x_S)=\sum_{A\subseteq S}w_A$，故忠实性等价于 $v(x_S)=\sum_{A\subseteq S}w_A$。

**Necessity 原计算：** 对每个 $S\subseteq N$，
\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{A\subseteq S}w_A
&=\sum_{A\subseteq S}\sum_{L\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}\sum_{A\subseteq S:A\supseteq L}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}\sum_{a=|L|}^{|S|}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq A\subseteq S\\|A|=a}}(-1)^{a-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}v(x_L)\sum_{m=0}^{|S|-|L|}\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m
=v(x_S).
\end{aligned}
\]
**Sufficiency 原证明：** 假设另一组系数 $\widetilde w_A$ 对全部掩码满足 $v(x_S)=\sum_{A\subseteq S}\widetilde w_A$。按 $|S|$ 归纳。作者列出三个基例：
\[
\widetilde w_\varnothing=v(x_\varnothing)=w_\varnothing;\quad
\widetilde w_{\{i\}}=v(x_{\{i\}})-v(x_\varnothing)=w_{\{i\}};\quad
\widetilde w_{\{i,j\}}=v(x_{\{i,j\}})-v(x_{\{i\}})-v(x_{\{j\}})+v(x_\varnothing)=w_{\{i,j\}}.
\]
原文字写“假设对任意 $|S|=s\ge2$ 成立，考虑 $|S|=s+1$”，计算中使用全部真子集的归纳结论：
\[
\begin{aligned}
v(x_S)&=\widetilde w_S+\sum_{A\subsetneq S}\widetilde w_A\\
&=\widetilde w_S+\sum_{A\subsetneq S}\sum_{L\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\widetilde w_S+\sum_{L\subsetneq S}\sum_{L\subseteq A\subsetneq S}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\widetilde w_S+\sum_{L\subsetneq S}\sum_{a=|L|}^{|S|-1}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq A\subsetneq S\\|A|=a}}(-1)^{a-|L|}v(x_L)\\
&=\widetilde w_S+\sum_{L\subsetneq S}v(x_L)\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|S|-|L|-1}\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m}_{0-(-1)^{|S|-|L|}}\\
&=\widetilde w_S-\sum_{L\subsetneq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v(x_L).
\end{aligned}
\]
移项得到 $\widetilde w_S=v(x_S)+\sum_{L\subsetneq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v(x_L)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v(x_L)=w_S$，从而唯一性成立。原文字归纳句与计算实际采用的强归纳作用范围在重写中明示；不修改原命题。

**Supplement D.1(1)，PDF第4页效率性质的独立原重证：** $v(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq N}w_S$。
\[
\begin{aligned}\sum_{S\subseteq N}w_S
&=\sum_{S\subseteq N}\sum_{U\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}v(x_U)\\
&=\sum_{U\subseteq N}\sum_{U\subseteq S\subseteq N}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}v(x_U)\\
&=\sum_{U\subseteq N}\sum_{s=|U|}^{n}\sum_{\substack{U\subseteq S\subseteq N\\|S|=s}}(-1)^{s-|U|}v(x_U)\\
&=\sum_{U\subseteq N}v(x_U)\sum_{m=0}^{n-|U|}\binom{n-|U|}m(-1)^m
=v(x).
\end{aligned}
\]
作者说明唯一没有消去的情形是U=N。该段与C重构证明重复，但作为本篇独立出现的完整证明保留。

en.title: Theorem 1: reconstruct every masked output
en.overview: Expand the dividends and exchange finite double sums. Opposite-sign pairing cancels every output coefficient except that of the retained set.
assumptions: Finite universe; the same input, model and input baseline are fixed.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$, input $x$ and input baseline vector $r$. The mask $x_S$ retains the original coordinates in $S$ and uses this same baseline elsewhere. The model is $v:X\to\mathbb R$, the game is $g(S)=v(x_S)$ and the output baseline is $b=g(\varnothing)$. The paper uses raw dividends $w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, so $w_\varnothing=b$. Centering $g_0=g-b$ changes only the empty dividend. A zero raw output baseline is not assumed.

en.proof_scope: entire original result; source proof and repaired proof separately preserved

proof_steps.title: Translate the original SCM into one fixed coefficient family
proof_steps.body_md: For a fixed input, model and baseline, $C_A(x_S)=1$ exactly when $A\subseteq S$. The theorem therefore concerns the same coefficients $w_A$ at every $S\subseteq N$. Statistical independence of input variables is not a premise of this finite algebra.

proof_steps.title: Exchange finite sums and cancel each interval
proof_steps.body_md: Expand $w_A$ at fixed $S$. Each pair $L\subseteq A\subseteq S$ occurs once, so exchange the finite sums. For fixed $L$, let $B=A\setminus L\subseteq S\setminus L$, a bijection with $|A|-|L|=|B|$. If $L\ne S$, choose a variable in the difference and pair subsets with and without it; opposite signs cancel. If $L=S$, only empty $B$ remains with coefficient 1. Thus only $g(S)$ survives.

proof_steps.title: Check the empty mask and two variables
proof_steps.body_md: At an empty mask the only term is $w_\varnothing=b$. For mask outputs 7, 8, 9 and 13 on two variables, the dividends are 7, 1, 2 and 3; reconstruction gives full output 13, empty output 7 and singleton outputs 8 and 9.

en.title: Appendix C: uniqueness of coefficients reconstructing all masks
en.overview: The empty mask fixes the constant coefficient. At each larger set, subtracting the already fixed proper-subset coefficients uniquely determines its coefficient.
assumptions: Finite universe; the same input, model and input baseline are fixed.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$, input $x$ and input baseline vector $r$. The mask $x_S$ retains the original coordinates in $S$ and uses this same baseline elsewhere. The model is $v:X\to\mathbb R$, the game is $g(S)=v(x_S)$ and the output baseline is $b=g(\varnothing)$. The paper uses raw dividends $w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. proof_steps.title: Keep every mask and one fixed coefficient family
proof_steps.body_md: Assume fixed coefficients $d_A$ reconstruct $g(S)$ for every $S\subseteq N$, including the empty set. An equality only at the full input cannot imply uniqueness.

proof_steps.title: Use strong induction on set cardinality
proof_steps.body_md: The empty set gives $d_\varnothing=g(\varnothing)=w_\varnothing$. The strong induction hypothesis says that every subset with cardinality below $|S|$ has its correct dividend. Every proper subset of $S$ is covered. Subtract the two reconstruction equalities at $S$ after replacing their identical proper-subset terms; the remaining terms give $d_S=w_S$. Since $S$ is arbitrary, all coefficients are unique.

proof_steps.title: Check the empty coefficient and necessary quantifiers
proof_steps.body_md: For outputs 7, 8, 9 and 13, the empty equation fixes coefficient 7, the singleton equations fix 1 and 2, and the full equation fixes 3. If only the full output 13 is required, putting all of 13 at the empty coefficient or all at the full-set coefficient both fit that one equality. Other masks cannot be omitted.

results.original_proof_md:
第4页原完整显示推导（输出下标固定为S，保留错误）：
\[
\begin{aligned}w^v_S&=\sum_{U\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}v(x_S)\\

&=\sum_{U\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}t(x_S)+\sum_{U\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}u(x_S)\\
&=w^t_S+w^u_S.\end{aligned}
\]
原式并非Harsanyi定义；问题和具体反例见 cvpr-issue-linearity-index。

\[
\begin{aligned}\Delta v_T(x_S)&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v(x_{L\cup S})\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{K\subseteq L\cup S}w_K\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{L'\subseteq L}\sum_{S'\subseteq S}w_{L'\cup S'}\\
&=\sum_{S'\subseteq S}\left[\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{L'\subseteq L}w_{L'\cup S'}\right]\\
&=\sum_{S'\subseteq S}\left[\sum_{L'\subseteq T}\sum_{L'\subseteq L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}w_{L'\cup S'}\right]\\
&=\sum_{S'\subseteq S}\left[w_{T\cup S'}+\sum_{L'\subsetneq T}\sum_{l=|L'|}^{|T|}\binom{|T|-|L'|}{l-|L'|}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}w_{L'\cup S'}\right]\\

&=\sum_{S'\subseteq S}w_{T\cup S'}.
\end{aligned}
\]

assumptions: $i\in N$；Shapley使用经典阶乘权重边际定义。

definitions.body_md:
固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$ 与输入基线向量 $r$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留原坐标、在其余坐标使用同一个 $r$。模型是 $v:X\to\mathbb R$，集合函数是 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线是 $b=g(\varnothing)$。本文原始交互为

w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U).
\]

results.original_statement_md: 正文第4页Theorem2（标明由[15]证明），补充第2、6页Theorem2：输入变量i的Shapley值为 $\phi(i)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\frac1{|S|+1}w_{S\cup\{i\}}$。作者解释为一个m变量模式的效应均分给这m个变量。
results.original_proof_md:
补充第6页末至第8页Theorem3之前，作者完整数学推导：设n=|N|，l=|L|。
\[
\begin{aligned}\phi(i)&=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\frac{|S|!(n-|S|-1)!}{n!}\Delta v_{\{i\}}(x_S)\\
&=\frac1n\sum_{m=0}^{n-1}\binom{n-1}{m}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}\Delta v_{\{i\}}(x_S)\\
&=\frac1n\sum_{m=0}^{n-1}\binom{n-1}{m}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}\sum_{L\subseteq S}w_{L\cup\{i\}}\\
&=\frac1n\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\sum_{m=0}^{n-1}\binom{n-1}{m}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}w_{L\cup\{i\}}\\
&=\frac1n\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\sum_{m=l}^{n-1}\binom{n-1}{m}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}w_{L\cup\{i\}}\\
&=\frac1n\sum_L\sum_{m=l}^{n-1}\binom{n-1}{m}^{-1}\binom{n-l-1}{m-l}w_{L\cup\{i\}}\\
&=\frac1n\sum_L w_{L\cup\{i\}}\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}\binom{n-1}{l+r}^{-1}\binom{n-l-1}{r}}_{\alpha_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
第7页文字把待简化项称为“term $w_L$”，紧接公式/后文使用 $\alpha_L$。作者列出三项材料：(i) $m\binom nm=n\binom{n-1}{m-1}$；(ii) 对p,q>0写 $B(p,q)=\int_0^1x^{p-1}(1-x)^{1-q}dx$（原指数错误保留）；(iii) 正整数p,q有 $B(p,q)=[q\binom{p+q-1}{p-1}]^{-1}$，及正整数n>m有 $\binom nm=[mB(n-m+1,m)]^{-1}$。
\[
\begin{aligned}\alpha_L&=\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}\binom{n-l-1}{r}(l+r)B(n-l-r,l+r)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}l\binom{n-l-1}{r}B(n-l-r,l+r)}_{\text{①}}
+\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}r\binom{n-l-1}{r}B(n-l-r,l+r)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}\text{①}&=\int_0^1l\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}\binom{n-l-1}{r}x^{n-l-r-1}(1-x)^{l+r-1}dx\\
&=\int_0^1l\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-1}\binom{n-l-1}{r}x^{n-l-r-1}(1-x)^r}_{=1}(1-x)^{l-1}dx
=\int_0^1l(1-x)^{l-1}dx=1.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}\text{②}&=\sum_{r=1}^{n-l-1}(n-l-1)\binom{n-l-2}{r-1}B(n-l-r,l+r)\\
&=(n-l-1)\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-2}\binom{n-l-2}{r'}B(n-l-r'-1,l+r'+1)\\
&=(n-l-1)\int_0^1\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-2}\binom{n-l-2}{r'}x^{n-l-r'-2}(1-x)^{l+r'}dx\\
&=(n-l-1)\int_0^1\underbrace{\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-2}\binom{n-l-2}{r'}x^{n-l-r'-2}(1-x)^{r'}}_{=1}(1-x)^l dx\\
&=(n-l-1)\int_0^1(1-x)^l dx=\frac{n-l-1}{l+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
因此作者写 $\alpha_L=1+(n-l-1)/(l+1)=n/(l+1)$，再得 $\phi(i)=\frac1n\sum_L\alpha_L w_{L\cup\{i\}}=\sum_L\frac1{l+1}w_{L\cup\{i\}}$。错误Beta定义、l=0零参数和①边界见统一issue；最后结论在项目中用不同但完整的有限证明保留。

definitions.body_md:

results.original_statement_md: 补充第2、8页Theorem3：$T\subseteq N$，$I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac{|S|!(|N|-|S|-|T|)!}{(|N|-|T|+1)!}\Delta v_T(x_S)$，则 $I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac1{|S|+1}w_{S\cup T}$；把T作为单个组成变量解释其均匀分配。
results.original_proof_md:
补充第8页Theorem3至第9页Theorem4之前的全部推导。令n=|N|、t=|T|、l=|L|、M=n−t。
\[
\begin{aligned}I^{\rm Shapley}(T)&=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac{|S|!(n-|S|-t)!}{(n-t+1)!}\Delta v_T(x_S)\\
&=\frac1{M+1}\sum_{m=0}^{M}\binom M m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\Delta v_T(x_S)\\
&=\frac1{M+1}\sum_{m=0}^{M}\binom M m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\sum_{L\subseteq S}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac1{M+1}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\sum_{m=l}^{M}\binom M m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac1{M+1}\sum_L\sum_{m=l}^{M}\binom M m^{-1}\binom{M-l}{m-l}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac1{M+1}\sum_Lw_{L\cup T}\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}\binom M{l+r}^{-1}\binom{M-l}{r}}_{\alpha_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
作者复用Theorem2的组合数/Beta材料：
\[
\begin{aligned}\alpha_L&=\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}\binom{M-l}r(l+r)B(M-l-r+1,l+r)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}l\binom{M-l}rB(M-l-r+1,l+r)}_{\text{①}}
+\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}r\binom{M-l}rB(M-l-r+1,l+r)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}\text{①}&=\int_0^1l\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}\binom{M-l}r x^{M-l-r}(1-x)^{l+r-1}dx\\
&=\int_0^1l\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{M-l}\binom{M-l}r x^{M-l-r}(1-x)^r}_{=1}(1-x)^{l-1}dx
=\int_0^1l(1-x)^{l-1}dx=1,\\
\text{②}&=\sum_{r=1}^{M-l}(M-l)\binom{M-l-1}{r-1}B(M-l-r+1,l+r)\\
&=(M-l)\sum_{r'=0}^{M-l-1}\binom{M-l-1}{r'}B(M-l-r',l+r'+1)\\
&=(M-l)\int_0^1\sum_{r'=0}^{M-l-1}\binom{M-l-1}{r'}x^{M-l-r'-1}(1-x)^{l+r'}dx\\
&=(M-l)\int_0^1\underbrace{\sum_{r'=0}^{M-l-1}\binom{M-l-1}{r'}x^{M-l-r'-1}(1-x)^{r'}}_{=1}(1-x)^l dx\\
&=(M-l)\int_0^1(1-x)^l dx=\frac{M-l}{l+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
于是原证明得 $\alpha_L=1+(M-l)/(l+1)=(M+1)/(l+1)$，$I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\frac1{M+1}\sum_L\alpha_Lw_{L\cup T}=\sum_Lw_{L\cup T}/(l+1)$。l=0时原①不成立；完整修正证明不改T的量词。

results.title: Theorem 4：Shapley–Taylor 的全部阶数分支
assumptions: $T\subseteq N$；k为正整数阶数；采用原三分支定义。

definitions.body_md:
固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$ 与输入基线向量 $r$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留原坐标、在其余坐标使用同一个 $r$。模型是 $v:X\to\mathbb R$，集合函数是 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线是 $b=g(\varnothing)$。本文原始交互为
\[
w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U).
\]
所有子集求和包括空集。特别地 $w_\varnothing=b$。若改用 $g_0=g-b$，只有空集交互改为零；本篇的原始输出没有零基线假设。

results.original_statement_md: 补充第2、9页Theorem4：对第k阶，k阶Shapley–Taylor指数满足：$|T|<k$ 时等于wT；$|T|=k$ 时等于 $\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{|S|+k}{k}^{-1}w_{S\cup T}$；$|T|>k$ 时为0。正阶数的域来自k-th order及其引用的定义，项目显式记录，不假定n≥k（当k>n只用第一分支）。 原文没有明写 $k>0$；本轮证明和Lean对齐的是正阶数的有效定义域，不能把此条件伪记为作者原文的不等式。$k=0$不属于当前有效域核验。
results.original_proof_md:
补充第9页末至第11页E之前的完整作者证明。原定义为
\[
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor(k)}(T)=\begin{cases}
\Delta v_T(x_\varnothing),&|T|<k,\\
\frac{k}{n}\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta v_T(x_S),&|T|=k,\\0,&|T|>k.
\end{cases}
\]
低阶分支直接按Harsanyi定义给 $\Delta v_T(x_\varnothing)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v(x_L)=w_T$。最高阶分支，n=|N|、l=|L|，作者计算
\[
\begin{aligned}I^{\rm ST(k)}(T)&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta v_T(x_S)\\
&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_{m=0}^{n-k}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta v_T(x_S)\\
&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_{m=0}^{n-k}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\sum_{L\subseteq S}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_L\sum_{m=l}^{n-k}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_L\sum_{m=l}^{n-k}\binom{n-1}{|S|}^{-1}\binom{n-l-k}{m-l}w_{L\cup T}\\
&=\frac{k}{n}\sum_Lw_{L\cup T}\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}\binom{n-1}{l+r}^{-1}\binom{n-l-k}r}_{\alpha_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
中间两行原稿在按m分组之后仍印|S|（S在内族满足|S|=m）；最后按r重新编号。
\[
\begin{aligned}\alpha_L&=\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}\binom{n-l-k}r(l+r)B(n-l-r,l+r)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}l\binom{n-l-k}r B(n-l-r,l+r)}_{\text{①}}
+\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}r\binom{n-l-k}r B(n-l-r,l+r)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}\text{①}&=\int_0^1l\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}\binom{n-l-k}r x^{n-l-r-1}(1-x)^{l+r-1}dx\\
&=\int_0^1l\underbrace{\sum_{r=0}^{n-l-k}\binom{n-l-k}r x^{n-l-r-k}(1-x)^r}_{=1}x^{k-1}(1-x)^{l-1}dx\\
&=lB(k,l)=\binom{l+k-1}{k-1}^{-1},\\
\text{②}&=(n-l-k)\sum_{r=1}^{n-l-k}\binom{n-l-k-1}{r-1}B(n-l-r,l+r)\\
&=(n-l-k)\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-k-1}\binom{n-l-k-1}{r'}B(n-l-r'-1,l+r'+1)\\
&=(n-l-k)\int_0^1\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-k-1}\binom{n-l-k-1}{r'}x^{n-l-r'-2}(1-x)^{l+r'}dx\\
&=(n-l-k)\int_0^1\underbrace{\sum_{r'=0}^{n-l-k-1}\binom{n-l-k-1}{r'}x^{n-l-r'-k-1}(1-x)^{r'}}_{=1}x^{k-1}(1-x)^l dx\\
&=(n-l-k)B(k,l+1)=\frac{n-l-k}{(l+1)\binom{l+k}{k-1}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
\[
\begin{aligned}\alpha_L&=\binom{l+k-1}{k-1}^{-1}+\frac{n-l-k}{(l+1)\binom{l+k}{k-1}}\\
&=\frac{l!(k-1)!}{(l+k-1)!}+\frac{n-l-k}{l+1}\frac{(l+1)!(k-1)!}{(l+k)!}\\
&=\frac{l!(k-1)!}{(l+k-1)!}+\frac{n-l-k}{l+k}\frac{l!(k-1)!}{(l+k-1)!}\\
&=\left[1+\frac{n-l-k}{l+k}\right]\frac{l!(k-1)!}{(l+k-1)!}
=\frac n{l+k}\frac{l!(k-1)!}{(l+k-1)!}
=\frac nk\frac{l!k!}{(l+k)!}=\frac nk\binom{l+k}k^{-1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
于是作者最终写 $I^{\rm ST(k)}(T)=\frac kn\sum_L\alpha_Lw_{L\cup T}=\sum_L\binom{l+k}k^{-1}w_{L\cup T}$。高阶为0由定义。原积分域与l=0问题保留在issue中。

**正文PDF第5页3.3，完整有关等价重组的推导段（中文翻译与公式转录）。** 原SCM表示And-Sum：
\[
v(x)\approx\sum_{S\in\Omega}w_SC_S(x)=\sum_{S\in\Omega}w_S.
\]
作者说这一And-Sum可等价转为AOG。三层AOG底层为n个输入变量，第二层每个AND节点编码孩子变量的AND关系；例如 $x_4x_5x_6$ 是 $S=\{x_4,x_5,x_6\}$ 的因果模式，其 $w_S=2.0$。根是noisy OR节点，累加所有孩子AND节点的效应：$\mathrm{output}=\sum_{S\in\Omega}w_SC_S$。
为进一步简化，作者提取不同模式共享的coalition作为新节点：$x_5,x_6$ 在多个模式里共同出现，于是设
\[
\beta=\{x_5,x_6\},\qquad
\{x_4,x_5,x_6\}\longmapsto\{x_4,\beta\}.
\]
于是每个中间层coalition/pattern S的触发状态由其全部孩子的触发状态相乘：
\[
C_S=\prod_{S'\in\operatorname{Child}(S)}C_{S'}.
\]
Child(S)是组成S的全部输入变量或coalition；S触发当且仅当所有孩子触发。上述内容是作者的未编号等价推导；没有独立的树归纳定理。MDL目标及其贪心选择属于下一算法段，单独登记，不伪称此段已证明全局最优。

en.title: AOG: equivalent regrouping of shared AND subpatterns
en.overview: A parent pattern is the union of its children’s variable sets. The product of their binary triggers equals the parent trigger, so sharing and regrouping preserve the weighted root output.
assumptions: Each parent pattern is the union of finitely many child variable sets. Triggers are containment indicators, and the original coefficients and linear root are retained. Children may be shared and their variables may overlap.

proof_steps.title: Combine two child AND triggers
proof_steps.body_md: Containment of $A\cup B$ in $T$ is equivalent to containment of both $A$ and $B$. The union trigger is therefore the product of the two binary triggers. Overlap between the child variable sets is allowed because trigger values are zero or one.

proof_steps.title: Repeated merging preserves each pattern state and the root output
proof_steps.body_md: For a finite child family with variable sets $V_c$, the parent set is their union. Induct over the child family. The empty family gives an empty union and empty product, both with trigger 1. Inserting a child uses the two-set union identity and the induction hypothesis, proving the product identity. Child variables may overlap and a child may be shared by several parents. Applying such a grouping to every original pattern preserves each trigger; retaining its coefficient preserves the weighted root output.

proof_steps.title: Check an empty pattern and a shared-node example
proof_steps.body_md: A shared node with variable set $\{5,6\}$ groups the pattern $\{4,5,6\}$ into children $\{4\}$ and that node. With mask $\{4,5\}$ neither representation fires; with the full pattern mask both fire. The empty pattern and empty child product both have trigger 1. This proves equivalent regrouping only; optimality of the MDL greedy algorithm is separate.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$, input $x$ and input baseline vector $r$. The mask $x_S$ retains the original coordinates in $S$ and uses this same baseline elsewhere. The model is $v:X\to\mathbb R$, the game is $g(S)=v(x_S)$ and the output baseline is $b=g(\varnothing)$. The paper uses raw dividends $w_A=I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, so $w_\varnothing=b$. Centering $g_0=g-b$ changes only the empty dividend. A zero raw output baseline is not assumed.

proof_steps.title: Evaluate each term at the fixed binary sample
proof_steps.body_md: For a monomial at input baseline zero, retaining its entire variable set keeps every factor; otherwise some factor is replaced by zero. Thus the masked monomial equals its coefficient times the original sample product times the containment indicator. An original zero factor makes that coefficient vanish; the empty monomial has product 1. Combine original terms with identical variable sets first.

proof_steps.title: Transform each pure AND response and combine by linearity
proof_steps.body_md: The finite addition–multiplication polynomial, evaluated on actual coordinate masks, is a sum of pure AND games by the preceding identity. Each has a dividend only at its own variable set. Finite linearity therefore makes a fixed set receive precisely its original coefficient times its sample product, if present in the polynomial, and zero otherwise.

proof_steps.title: Check both source samples and the boundary
proof_steps.body_md: The source model is $v(x)=3x_1-2x_2x_3-x_3x_4x_5+5x_4x_6$. At the all-ones sample its nonzero dividends are 3, −2, −1 and 5 at the four displayed monomial sets. When the third coordinate is zero, only dividends 3 and 5 remain. Full outputs are respectively 5 and 8. Both examples have zero empty-mask output and empty dividend; these are exact activated-term coefficients.

results.original_statement_md:
Given \(v\), \(x=[x_1,\ldots,x_n]^\top\), and \(N=\{1,\ldots,n\}\), the Harsanyi interaction is
\[
I(S)\stackrel{\rm def}{=}\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}u(T),\qquad
u(T)\stackrel{\rm def}{=}v(x_T)-v(x_\varnothing).\tag{1}
\]
The variables in \(N\setminus T\) are masked using \(b=[b_1,\ldots,b_n]^\top\), and those in \(T\) remain unchanged. In particular, \(u(\varnothing)=I(\varnothing)=0\). For classification, the paper uses \(v(x)=\log[p(y=y^{\rm truth}\mid x)/(1-p(y=y^{\rm truth}\mid x))]\).

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 1. Let the input sample \(x\) be arbitrarily masked to obtain \(x_S\). The output can be disentangled into all interaction effects within \(S\):
\[
\forall S\subseteq N,\qquad v(x_S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}I(T)+v(x_\varnothing).\tag{7}
\]
results.original_proof_md:
## B.1 — Proof of Theorem 1（PDF 15）

According to the definition of the Harsanyi interaction, we have \(\forall S\subseteq N\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{T\subseteq S}I(T)
&=\sum_{T\subseteq S}\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}u(L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}\sum_{T\subseteq S:T\supseteq L}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}u(L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}\sum_{t=|L|}^{|S|}\sum_{\substack{T\subseteq S:S\supseteq L\\|T|=t}}(-1)^{t-|L|}u(L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}u(L)\sum_{m=0}^{|S|-|L|}\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m\\
&=u(S)=v(x_S)-v(x_\varnothing).
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, we have \(v(x_S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}I(T)+v(x_\varnothing)\).

转录注：原第三行内层限制实际印为 \(T\subseteq S:S\supseteq L\)，保留原式；与上一行 \(T\supseteq L\) 的正确分组条件不同。这一求和索引排印问题不改变 Theorem 1 陈述；项目证明按正确索引明确给双射。

设 \(I(T)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g_0(L)\)。对每个 \(S\subseteq N\)，有
\[
v(x_S)=b+\sum_{T\subseteq S}I(T).
\]
所有求和都包含空集；由定义 \(I(\varnothing)=g_0(\varnothing)=0\)。固定 \(L\subseteq S\) 后，双重求和中包含该 \(L\) 的 \(T\) 恰为 \(L\cup U\)，其中 \(U\subseteq S\setminus L\)。这是有限集合的双射，且 \(|T|-|L|=|U|\)。因此
\[
\sum_{T\subseteq S}I(T)
=\sum_{L\subseteq S}g_0(L)\sum_{U\subseteq S\setminus L}(-1)^{|U|}
=\sum_{L\subseteq S}g_0(L)(1-1)^{|S\setminus L|}=g_0(S).
\]

results.overview:
原文使用 \(\approx\) 而未规定统一误差容限。其数学依据是 Theorem 1 的确切余项分解：若 \(\Omega\subseteq2^N\) 是保留交互集合，对每个 \(S\subseteq N\)，
\[
v(x_S)-\left[b+\sum_{T\subseteq S,\,T\in\Omega}I(T)\right]
=\sum_{T\subseteq S,\,T\notin\Omega}I(T).
\]
这是将有限索引族分为属于 \(\Omega\) 与不属于 \(\Omega\) 的两组再应用重构。只有当遗漏项的合计足够小时，作者的近似符号才有相应数值含义；“每个遗漏项很小”与“所有掩码均有可认证的小总误差”不能无条件互换。此处解释作者近似的依赖，不把项目补出的误差标准称作原文定理。

proof_steps.title: 定义、目标与原条件
proof_steps.body_md:
## Lemma 1：作者的无限 Taylor 交互公式与上下文边界

作者对非空 \(S\) 声称
\[
I(S)=\sum_{\kappa\in Q_S}\frac{D^\kappa v(r)}{\kappa!}\prod_{i\in S}(x_i-r_i)^{\kappa_i},
\quad Q_S=\{\kappa\in\mathbb N^n:\kappa_i>0\ (i\in S),\ \kappa_i=0\ (i\notin S)\}.
\]
其完整路线是：定义右边为 \(\widetilde I(S)\)，另设 \(\widetilde I(\varnothing)=0\)；把每个掩码的 Taylor 展开按多重指标的非零坐标集合分组，得到 \(v(x_S)=b+\sum_{T\subseteq S}\widetilde I(T)\)；再用全部掩码上的重构唯一性识别 \(\widetilde I=I\)。唯一性必须覆盖包括空集的全部掩码，不能只从完整输入一个等式得出。

一般光滑函数未必等于其 Taylor 级数，故原 Lemma 单独读作无解析前提的全称式时有反例：\(v(t)=e^{-1/t^2}\)（\(t\ne0\)），\(v(0)=0\)，在0处所有导数为0，而 \(I(\{1\})=v(1)-v(0)=e^{-1}\)。原式和完整原证明仍保留；该一般陈述不能靠补解析性改成另一条命题。若把此前 Eq. (2) 的函数等于 Taylor 展开直接当成给定表示条件，该反例也不满足 Eq. (2)，因此不能称“满足原 Eq. (2) 仍反驳 Lemma”。这里明确区分一般光滑函数读法的有效性缺口与给定 Taylor 表示下的分组/唯一性推导。这个反例不满足原 Assumption 1-β 的“全空间高阶导数零”，不否定下一条在该背景下的有限阶推论。

proof_steps.title: Definitions, original target, and premise adapter
proof_steps.body_md:
For nonempty S the author claims
$I(S)=\sum_{\kappa\in Q_S}D^\kappa v(r)\prod_{i\in S}(x_i-r_i)^{\kappa_i}/\kappa!$,
where $Q_S$ consists of multiindices positive on S and zero elsewhere. Define this right-hand side as $\widetilde I(S)$ and set $\widetilde I(\varnothing)=0$. Group every masked Taylor expansion by its nonzero-coordinate support to obtain $v(x_S)=b+\sum_{T\subseteq S}\widetilde I(T)$, then invoke coefficient uniqueness for all masks, including the empty mask. A single full-input equality cannot establish uniqueness.
A smooth function need not equal its Taylor series: $v(t)=e^{-1/t^2}$ for nonzero t and $v(0)=0$ has all derivatives zero at 0, but $I(\{1\})=e^{-1}$. This refutes the unrestricted smooth-function reading; adding analyticity would change the original proposition. If Eq. (2) is instead a given valid Taylor representation, that example does not satisfy it and does not refute the conditional grouping argument. It also does not satisfy the global high-order zero-derivative Assumption 1-β, so it does not refute the next finite-order implication. The original formula and proof are retained.

proof_steps.title: 把原混合导数的存在与顺序展开
proof_steps.body_md:
固定 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$、模型 $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$、输入 $x$ 与输入基线 $r$。掩码在集合 $A$ 内取 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$，定义 $g(A)=v(x_A)$、$b=g(\varnothing)$、$g_0(A)=g(A)-b$。原Sparse交互为 $I(A)=I_{g_0}(A)=\sum_{L\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}g_0(L)$，故 $I(\varnothing)=0$。$e_i$ 是坐标单位向量；$a_i=x_i-r_i$ 是第 $i$ 个坐标的实际掩码增量。

经典偏导定义为 $D_i f(z)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}f(z+t e_i)\right|_{t=0}$。这等于把其余坐标固定、以第 $i$ 个坐标值为参数的普通导数。用非降序坐标列表 $(i_1,\ldots,i_q)$ 编码多重指标 $\kappa_i$：它等于列表中 $i$ 的出现次数，$q=\sum_i\kappa_i$。从左到右依次取偏导，定义 $P_0=v$、$P_j=D_{i_j}P_{j-1}$。原1-β的经典“混合导数存在且为零”要求相应前缀偏导沿下一坐标的导数真实存在，并给出 $P_q(z)=0$ 对全部 $z$。项目把这些存在条件与高阶零值一起编码在同一个1-β谓词中，只对原要求的 $q>M$ 列表使用它；没有另加所有低阶导数全局光滑的假设。原C1背景保留，但C1本身不保证高阶导数存在。原分母排写未另说明操作顺序，项目固定升序依次取导；如果采用反序约定，通用差分引理按同样的反序使用即可，不靠混合偏导换序。

proof_steps.title: Classical mixed partials and their existence order
proof_steps.body_md:
Fix $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, x, and r. A mask keeps x_i on A and r_i elsewhere. Set $g(A)=v(x_A)$, $b=g(\varnothing)$, and $g_0=g-b$. The source interaction is $I_{g_0}$, so its empty value is zero. Let e_i be a coordinate unit vector and $a_i=x_i-r_i$.
The classical partial is $D_i f(z)=\left.\frac d{dt}f(z+t e_i)\right|_{t=0}$. Encode a multiindex by a nondecreasing coordinate list $(i_1,\ldots,i_q)$, and define $P_0=v$, $P_j=D_{i_j}P_{j-1}$. Classical existence of the stated mixed partials includes actual differentiability of each required prefix along the next coordinate, and 1-β gives $P_q\equiv0$. These existence conditions and the zero value are encoded together; only lists q>M are used. No extra global smoothness of all low derivatives is assumed. C1 alone does not imply existence of high derivatives. A fixed ascending order is used; a reverse convention can use the same difference argument in reverse order, without interchanging mixed partials.

results.overview:
令 \(A^{(k)}=\sum_{T\subseteq N,|T|=k}I(T)\)，\(n=|N|\)，并使用原 Assumption 1-α。对 \(M\le m\le n\)，
\[
\bar g_0^{(m)}=\frac1{\binom nm}\sum_{S\subseteq N,|S|=m}g_0(S)
=\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}A^{(k)}.
\]
先对每个 \(m\) 元掩码用重构，空集交互为0，再按交互阶数分组：
\[
\sum_{|S|=m}g_0(S)=\sum_{k=1}^m\sum_{|S|=m}\sum_{T\subseteq S,|T|=k}I(T).
\]
对一个固定 \(k\) 元 \(T\subseteq N\)，含它的 \(m\) 元集合 \(S\) 与 \(N\setminus T\) 的 \((m-k)\) 元子集 \(U\) 通过 \(S=T\cup U\) 一一对应。因此这个 \(I(T)\) 出现 \(\binom{n-k}{m-k}\) 次，有限换序给
\[
\sum_{|S|=m}\sum_{T\subseteq S,|T|=k}I(T)=\binom{n-k}{m-k}A^{(k)}.
\]
因为 \(k\le m\le n\)，两相关分母正且
\[
\binom nm\binom mk=\binom nk\binom{n-k}{m-k},\qquad
\frac{\binom{n-k}{m-k}}{\binom nm}=\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}.
\]
除以 \(\binom nm\)，得到到 \(m\) 阶的公式。原截断前提使 \(k>M\) 的每个交互都为0，从而 \(A^{(k)}=0\)，只留下到 \(M\) 的和。更低的 \(m<M\) 也可用同一计数（把 \(k>m\) 的 \(\binom mk\) 记为0）；这是证明 Theorem 2 调用范围的补全，不改变本引理已陈述的量词。\(m=0\) 时中心化平均为0。

results.original_statement_md:
Lemma 3. Given \(n,M\in\mathbb N^+\), \(M<n\), if
\[
\forall m\in\{n,n-1,\ldots,n-M\},\qquad\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}w_k=0,
\]
then \(w_k=0\) for \(k=1,\ldots,M\).
results.original_proof_md:
## B.3 — Proof of Lemma 3（PDF 17–18）

The problem is represented by \(Cw=0\), where
\[
C=\begin{bmatrix}
\binom n1/\binom n1&\binom n2/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom nM/\binom nM\\
\binom{n-1}1/\binom n1&\binom{n-1}2/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-1}M/\binom nM\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}1/\binom n1&\binom{n-M}2/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-M}M/\binom nM
\end{bmatrix}\in\mathbb R^{(M+1)\times M},\quad
w=[w_1,w_2,\ldots,w_M]^\top\in\mathbb R^M.\tag{28}
\]
It suffices to prove \(\operatorname{rank}(C)=M\). Subtract the \((i+1)\)-th row from the \(i\)-th row for \(i=1,\ldots,M\), using \(\binom nm-\binom{n-1}m=\binom{n-1}{m-1}\). The rank is unchanged and the resulting matrix is
\[
C'=\begin{bmatrix}
\binom{n-1}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-1}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-1}{M-1}/\binom nM\\
\binom{n-2}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-2}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-1}/\binom nM\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-M}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-M}{M-1}/\binom nM\\
\binom{n-M}1/\binom n1&\binom{n-M}2/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-M}M/\binom nM
\end{bmatrix}.\tag{29}
\]
The proof shows that the first \(M\) rows are independent by a nonzero determinant:
\[
D\stackrel{\rm def}{=}\det\begin{bmatrix}
\binom{n-1}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-1}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-1}{M-1}/\binom nM\\
\binom{n-2}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-2}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-1}/\binom nM\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}0/\binom n1&\binom{n-M}1/\binom n2&\cdots&\binom{n-M}{M-1}/\binom nM
\end{bmatrix}\ne0.\tag{30}
\]
The original recursive determinant calculation is
\[
\begin{aligned}
D\prod_{k=1}^M\binom nk
&=\det\begin{bmatrix}
\binom{n-1}0&\binom{n-1}1&\cdots&\binom{n-1}{M-1}\\
\binom{n-2}0&\binom{n-2}1&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-1}\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}0&\binom{n-M}1&\cdots&\binom{n-M}{M-1}
\end{bmatrix}\quad\text{(31)}\\
&=\det\begin{bmatrix}
0&\binom{n-2}0&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-2}\\
0&\binom{n-3}0&\cdots&\binom{n-3}{M-2}\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}0&\binom{n-M}1&\cdots&\binom{n-M}{M-1}
\end{bmatrix}&&\text{subtracting row }i+1\text{ from row }i\quad\text{(32)}\\
&=\det\begin{bmatrix}
\binom{n-2}0&\binom{n-2}1&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-2}\\
\binom{n-3}0&\binom{n-2}1&\cdots&\binom{n-2}{M-2}\\
\vdots&\vdots&\ddots&\vdots\\
\binom{n-M}0&\binom{n-M}1&\cdots&\binom{n-M}{M-2}
\end{bmatrix}\quad\text{(33)}\\
&=\cdots\quad\text{(34)}\\
&=1.\quad\text{(35)}
\end{aligned}
\]
Now, the original proof states
\[
D=\frac1{\prod_{k=1}^M\binom nk}\ne0.\tag{36}
\]
This leads to: if \(\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}w_k=0\) for all \(m\in\{n,n-1,\ldots,n-M\}\), then \(w_k=0\) for \(1\le k\le M\).

原命题设 \(1\le M<n\)。若对 \(j=0,1,\ldots,M\)，
\[
\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom{n-j}k}{\binom nk}w_k=0,
\]
则所有 \(w_k=0\)。作者消元得到的 \(D\) 具有非零行列式，但原 Eq. (35)–(36) 漏了符号：按它的递减行序，
\[
D=\frac{(-1)^{M(M-1)/2}}{\prod_{k=1}^M\binom nk}\ne0.
\]
沿 Eq. (32) 的首列展开时，唯一非零元素在末行，余子式符号为 \((-1)^{M+1}\)；继续降一阶产生 \((-1)^M\)，直到1阶，乘积即上式的交错符号。各 \(\binom nk>0\)，因此正确符号仍证明满列秩。

proof_steps.title: 全量有限差分归纳
proof_steps.body_md:
实际 Lean 使用完整的有限差分路线，避免计算行列式。先证明一般辅助命题：若 \(M\le n\) 且 \(\sum_{k=0}^M\binom{n-j}k a_k=0\) 对所有 \(0\le j\le M\) 成立，则 \(a_0,\ldots,a_M\) 都为0。对 \(M\) 归纳：\(M=0\) 时和就是 \(a_0\)。归纳步把相邻两行相减，使用
\[
\binom{n-j}{k+1}-\binom{n-j-1}{k+1}=\binom{n-j-1}k,
\]
得到 \(\sum_{k=0}^{M-1}\binom{(n-1)-j}k a_{k+1}=0\)，其中 \(0\le j\le M-1\)。归纳假设允许任意系数函数及任意 \(n\)，故可用于平移的系数 \(k\mapsto a_{k+1}\) 与 \(n-1\)，推出 \(a_1,\ldots,a_M=0\)。回代第一行得到 \(a_0=0\)。最后取 \(a_0=0\)、\(a_k=w_k/\binom nk\)，正分母允许从 \(a_k=0\) 推 \(w_k=0\)。这证明原完整量词，没有缩成几个固定矩阵。声明为 `Harsanyi.Sparsity.binomial_matrix_kernel`。

proof_steps.title: Repair the determinant sign
proof_steps.body_md: Expand the first column in Eq. (32). Its only nonzero entry is in the last row, giving cofactor sign $(-1)^{M+1}$. Repeating in one lower dimension gives the next factor $(-1)^M$, continuing to order 1 and producing the sign above. Every binomial denominator is positive, so the corrected determinant still establishes rank.

proof_steps.title: Complete finite-difference induction
proof_steps.body_md: Lean uses finite differences instead of a determinant. Prove: if $M\le n$ and $\sum_{k=0}^M\binom{n-j}k a_k=0$ for j=0,…,M, all a_k vanish. Induct on M. At $M=0$ the equation is a₀=0. Subtract adjacent rows and use $\binom{n-j}{k+1}-\binom{n-j-1}{k+1}=\binom{n-j-1}k$. This gives the degree-M−1 system for shifted coefficients a_{k+1} and n−1. The induction hypothesis quantifies over arbitrary coefficient functions and n, so it yields a₁,…,a_$M=0$. Substitute into the first row to obtain a₀=0. Finally take a₀=0 and $a_k=w_k/\binom nk$; positive denominators recover w_k=0. `Harsanyi.Sparsity.binomial_matrix_kernel` proves the general statement, not a few fixed matrices.

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 2. There exists \(m_0\in\{n,n-1,\ldots,n-M\}\) such that for all \(1\le k\le M\),
\[
A^{(k)}=\left(\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)}.\tag{37}
\]
Here \(|\lambda^{(k)}|\le1\), \(|a_0^{(k)}|<n\), \(|a_i^{(k)}|\in\{0,1,\ldots,n-1\}\) for \(i=1,\ldots,\lfloor p\rfloor-1\), and
\[
\delta\le\log_n\left[\frac1\lambda\left(1-\frac{a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}}{n^{p-\lfloor p\rfloor+1}}-\cdots-\frac{a_0}{n^p}\right)\right]\quad\text{if }\lambda>0,\tag{38}
\]
\[
\delta\le\log_n\left[\frac1{-\lambda}\left(\frac{a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}}{n^{p-\lfloor p\rfloor+1}}+\cdots+\frac{a_0}{n^p}\right)\right]\quad\text{if }\lambda<0.\tag{39}
\]
\[
\lambda\stackrel{\rm def}{=}\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom{m_0}k}{\binom nk}\lambda^{(k)}\ne0,
\qquad a_i\stackrel{\rm def}{=}\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom{m_0}k}{\binom nk}a_i^{(k)},\quad i=0,\ldots,\lfloor p\rfloor-1.
\]
The main-text copies of these expressions are numbered (3)–(5).
results.original_proof_md:
## B.3 — Proof of Theorem 2（PDF 19–20）

By Assumption 3 with \(m'=1\), \(\bar u^{(m)}\le m^p\bar u^{(1)}\). Assumption 2 gives \(\bar u^{(m)}\ge\bar u^{(0)}=v(x_\varnothing)-v(x_\varnothing)=0\). With Lemma 2,
\[
\forall M\le m\le n,\quad0\le\bar u^{(m)}=\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}A^{(k)}\le m^p\bar u^{(1)}.\tag{40}
\]
For each \(1\le k\le M\), consider the \(n\)-ary representation after division by \(\bar u^{(1)}\):
\[
\frac{A^{(k)}}{\bar u^{(1)}}=a_{q^{(k)}}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}}+a_{q^{(k)}-1}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)},\tag{41}
\]
\[
A^{(k)}=\left(a_{q^{(k)}}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}}+a_{q^{(k)}-1}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)}.\tag{42}
\]
Here \(q^{(k)}\in\mathbb N\), \(|a_i^{(k)}|\in\{0,1,\ldots,n-1\}\) for \(1\le i\le q^{(k)}\), and \(|a_0^{(k)}|<n\); the decimal part is absorbed into \(a_0^{(k)}\).

Case 1: \(q^{(k)}\le\lfloor p\rfloor-1\). Then
\[
A^{(k)}=\left(\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_{q^{(k)}+1}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}+1}+a_{q^{(k)}}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)},\tag{43}
\]
with \(\lambda^{(k)}=a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}=\cdots=a_{q^{(k)}+1}^{(k)}=0\) and arbitrary \(\delta\) (its choice and range discussed in Case 2).

Case 2: \(q^{(k)}\ge\lfloor p\rfloor\). Merge all degree terms at least \(\lfloor p\rfloor\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
A^{(k)}
&=\left(\underbrace{a_{q^{(k)}}^{(k)}n^{q^{(k)}}+\cdots+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor}}_{=:s^{(k)}n^{p+\delta^{(k)}}}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)}\quad\text{(44)}\\
&=\left(s^{(k)}n^{p+\delta^{(k)}}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)}.\quad\text{(45)}
\end{aligned}
\]
The sign \(s^{(k)}\in\{-1,1\}\). Let \(G=\{k:1\le k\le M,q^{(k)}\ge\lfloor p\rfloor\}\), \(\delta=\max_{k\in G}\delta^{(k)}\), and \(k^*=\arg\max_{k\in G}\delta^{(k)}\). For \(k\in G\),
\[
s^{(k)}n^{p+\delta^{(k)}}=\underbrace{s^{(k)}n^{\delta^{(k)}-\delta}}_{=:\lambda^{(k)}}n^{p+\delta}=\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta},\tag{46}
\]
\[
|\lambda^{(k)}|=|s^{(k)}n^{\delta^{(k)}-\delta}|=|n^{\delta^{(k)}-\delta}|\le1.\tag{47}
\]
In particular, \(|\lambda^{(k^*)}|=1\). Thus for any \(k\in G\),
\[
A^{(k)}=\left(\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_1^{(k)}n+a_0^{(k)}\right)\bar u^{(1)},\tag{48}
\]
with the stated digit bounds. Plugging this into Eq. (40) gives
\[
\bar u^{(m)}=\left[
\left(\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}\lambda^{(k)}\right)n^{p+\delta}
+\left(\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}^{(k)}\right)n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}
+\cdots+\left(\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom mk}{\binom nk}a_0^{(k)}\right)\right]\bar u^{(1)}.\tag{49}
\]
Lemma 3 implies
\[
\exists m_0\in\{n,n-1,\ldots,n-M\},\quad\sum_{k=1}^M\frac{\binom{m_0}k}{\binom nk}\lambda^{(k)}\ne0.\tag{50}
\]
Indeed, if this sum were zero for every row, Lemma 3 would give every \(\lambda^{(k)}=0\), contradicting \(|\lambda^{(k^*)}|=1\). Let \(\lambda=\sum_k\frac{\binom{m_0}k}{\binom nk}\lambda^{(k)}\ne0\), \(a_i=\sum_k\frac{\binom{m_0}k}{\binom nk}a_i^{(k)}\). Then
\[
0\le\bar u^{(m_0)}=\left(\lambda n^{p+\delta}+a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}n^{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}+\cdots+a_1n+a_0\right)\bar u^{(1)}\le m_0^p\bar u^{(1)}\le n^p\bar u^{(1)}.\tag{51}
\]
When \(\lambda>0\), the right inequality gives
\[
\delta\le\log_n\left[\frac1\lambda\left(1-\frac{a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}}{n^{p-\lfloor p\rfloor+1}}-\cdots-\frac{a_0}{n^p}\right)\right].\tag{52}
\]
When \(\lambda<0\), the left inequality gives
\[
\delta\le\log_n\left[\frac1{-\lambda}\left(\frac{a_{\lfloor p\rfloor-1}}{n^{p-\lfloor p\rfloor+1}}+\cdots+\frac{a_0}{n^p}\right)\right].\tag{53}
\]

原式问题保留：\(\bar u^{(1)}=0\) 的除法、\(G=\varnothing\) 的最大值以及 \(m_0<M\) 时 Eq. (40) 的引用范围是原路线缺口；不会由它们直接判断系数存在式为假。

proof_steps.title: 正均值的归一化与对数界
proof_steps.body_md:
当 \(\mu_1>0\) 时，取
\[
C=1+\sum_{k=1}^M\left|\frac{A^{(k)}}{\mu_1}\right|>0,
\quad\delta=\log_n C-p,\quad
\lambda^{(k)}=\frac{A^{(k)}}{\mu_1C},\quad a_i^{(k)}=0.
\]
在原对数/组合分母的定义域 \(n>1\)、\(1\le M\le n\) 内（包括 \(M=n\)），故 \(n^{p+\delta}=C\)。对所有 \(1\le k\le M\)，\(|\lambda^{(k)}|\le1\)，且 \(A^{(k)}=\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta}\mu_1\)，各低位界也满足。取 \(m_0=n\)，组合比值全为1；截断重构给 \(\sum_kA^{(k)}=\mu_n\)，所以
\[
\lambda=\sum_{k=1}^M\lambda^{(k)}=\frac{\mu_n}{\mu_1C}>0,
\qquad a_i=0.
\]
于是 \(\lambda C=\mu_n/\mu_1\le n^p\)。以底数 \(n>1\) 的单调对数取对数，得到 \(p+\delta\le p+\log_n(1/\lambda)\)，即原正 \(\lambda\) 分支的 \(\delta\le\log_n(1/\lambda)\)。负分支是条件命题，这个见证的 \(\lambda>0\) 不触发它。

proof_steps.body_md: 当 \(\mu_1=0\) 时，对每个 \(1\le m\le n\)，原两假设给 \(0\le\mu_m\le m^p\mu_1=0\)，故 \(\mu_m=0\)。对 \(k=1,\ldots,M\) 递推：均值计数公式在 \(m=k\) 时，较低阶 \(A^{(j)}\) 已为0，\(j>k\) 的组合系数为0，剩下 \(0=A^{(k)}/\binom nk\)，所以 \(A^{(k)}=0\)。这个三角递推包含第一阶起点，不从均值零擅推所有掩码输出零。

proof_steps.title: 定义、目标与原条件
proof_steps.body_md:
## 渐近稀疏解释的范围

作者把精确计数式解释为 \(O(n^{p+\delta}/|\tau\eta|)\) 且通常远少于全部潜在交互。\(p\) 小、抵消比例不小和阈值合理在实验中有依据，但若参数和 \(\delta\) 随 \(n\) 变化，该大O表达本身不给统一渐近界。原“most cases”描述与原条件定理分别展示，不升级成未陈述的全称渐近结论。

第8页 Case 2 另有明确推断：“\(R^{(k)}\) is still much less than \(\binom nk\) if \(|\eta^{(k)}|\) is not exponentially small”。原句未附加“大 \(k\)”前提。以下无限族满足原三项形式条件，却有非指数小的抵消比例和完全稠密的同阶显著交互；反例只针对这条 Case 2 推断。
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: 无限参数族与完整符号划分
proof_steps.body_md:
构造有限符号族。取任意 \(n\ge3\) 且 \(n\equiv2,3\pmod4\)，令 \(N=\{1,\ldots,n\}\)、\(q=\binom n2=n(n-1)/2\)。此时 \(q\) 为奇数：\(n=4j+2\) 时 \(q=(2j+1)(4j+1)\)，\(n=4j+3\) 时 \(q=(4j+3)(2j+1)\)。特别地，\(n=4j+3\)、\(j\in\mathbb N\) 是一个无限子族。在 \(q\) 个二元集合中任取 \((q-1)/2\) 个为正族 \(P\)，其余 \((q+1)/2\) 个为负族 \(Q\)。有限集合的所需基数不超过总数，故这样的划分存在。对二元集合定义 \(c_A=1\)（\(A\in P\)）或 \(c_A=-1\)（\(A\in Q\)），于是
\[
\sum_{|A|=2}c_A=\frac{q-1}{2}-\frac{q+1}{2}=-1.
\]
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: 实际模型及其全部交互系数
proof_steps.body_md:
固定同一输入 \(x=(1,\ldots,1)\)、输入基线 \(r=0\)，取光滑二次模型
\[
v_n(z)=\sum_{i=1}^n z_i+\sum_{\substack{A\subseteq N\\|A|=2}}c_A\prod_{i\in A}z_i.
\]
它的输出基线为 \(v_n(r)=0\)。纯 AND 单项式的交互分布及有限和线性性给 \(I(\{i\})=1\)、\(I(A)=c_A\)（\(|A|=2\)），其他阶及空交互均为零。因此 \(A^{(1)}=n\)、\(A^{(2)}=-1\)。这也可以实现为有限平方激活网络，因为 \(z_i z_j=((z_i+z_j)^2-z_i^2-z_j^2)/2\)；这里不引入或假设额外“well-trained”的数学谓词。
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: 逐项验证原三假设
proof_steps.body_md:
验证原截断与平均条件。取 \(M=2<n\)。二次模型的所有总阶至少3的混合偏导在全空间为零，所以更强的 1-β 也成立，1-α 直接由上面的真实交互系数成立。一个固定二元集合在均匀 \(m\) 元掩码中被包含的概率为 \(\binom m2/q\)。对全部 \(0\le m\le n\)，原均值恰为
\[
\mu_m=\bar u^{(m)}=m+\frac{\binom m2}{q}\sum_{|A|=2}c_A
=m-\frac{\binom m2}{q}.
\]
对 \(0\le m<n\)，
\[
\mu_{m+1}-\mu_m=1-\frac m q\ge1-\frac{n-1}{q}
=1-\frac2n>0.
\]
故任意 \(0\le m'\le m\le n\) 都有 \(\mu_{m'}\le\mu_m\)，满足 Assumption 2。对 \(m\ge1\)，
\[
\frac{\mu_m}{m}=1-\frac{m-1}{2q}.
\]
此比值随 \(m\) 非增，所以任意 \(1\le m'\le m\le n\) 有 \(\mu_{m'}\ge(m'/m)\mu_m\)。当 \(m'=0\) 时两边为零。原 Assumption 3 以固定 \(p=1\) 成立，不需要新增假设。
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: 原阈值、抵消比例与同阶稠密性
proof_steps.body_md:
固定显著阈值并计算抵消比。取 \(\tau=1/100\)。每个二元集合的交互绝对值都为1，故所有二阶交互显著，且
\[
R^{(2)}=q=\binom n2,\qquad
\sum_{|A|=2}|I(A)|=q,\qquad
\eta^{(2)}=\frac{A^{(2)}}{\sum_{|A|=2}|I(A)|}=-\frac1q.
\]
对每个二元集合 \(A\)，四个子集输出为 \(0,1,1,2+c_A\)，都非负；其平均绝对输出为 \(3/4\) 或 \(5/4\)。这个固定阈值相对两者都足够小，符合原文该定性阈值选择。\(|\eta^{(2)}|=2/[n(n-1)]\) 只按多项式衰减，且 \(n|\eta^{(2)}|=2/(n-1)\to0\)，确实落在作者近乎抵消的 Case 2；它不是指数小。然而 \(R^{(2)}/\binom n2=1\) 恒成立，无法成为“much less”。
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: 精确T3仍成立与反驳子句的范围
proof_steps.body_md:
核对反例的影响范围。Theorem 3 的精确右端在代入同一个阶总效应后为
\[
\frac{|A^{(2)}|}{\tau|\eta^{(2)}|}=100q,
\qquad R^{(2)}=q\le100q.
\]
因此精确 T2 系数存在性及 T3 阈值计数式均保持成立；失败的是从非指数小抵消比例推出同阶稀疏的额外 Case 2 推断。反例没有把相邻 “in most cases” 的经验描述改成全称命题。全模型只有 \(n+q=O(n^2)\) 个非零交互，仍远少于 \(2^n\)，所以也不能把这个同阶反例说成对“相对全部 \(2^n\) 组合稀疏”的反驳。本段是项目完整反例证明，不是原作者证明，也没有新增 Lean 通过声明。
proof_steps.justification: 原条件、明确有限索引依据与完整共享证明；修复只改变证明步骤。

proof_steps.title: Scope of the asymptotic interpretation
proof_steps.body_md: The exact count is described asymptotically as O(n^{p+δ}/|τη|), usually far below all possible interactions. Small p, moderate cancellation, and suitable thresholds have empirical support, but n-dependent parameters and δ need not give a uniform asymptotic bound. Keep the “most cases” discussion separate. Page 8 Case 2 also claims that $R^{(k)}$ is much less than choose(n,k) if $|\eta^{(k)}|$ is not exponentially small, without a large-k premise. The following infinite family refutes that additional inference alone.
proof_steps.justification: The original premises, explicit finite-index arguments, and complete shared proofs are retained. Repairs change proof steps only.

proof_steps.title: Infinite parameter family and sign partition
proof_steps.body_md: For $n\ge3$ with $n\equiv2,3\pmod4$, let $q=\binom n2=n(n-1)/2$. It is odd: at $n=4j+2$ it is $(2j+1)(4j+1)$, and at $n=4j+3$ it is $(4j+3)(2j+1)$. In particular $n=4j+3$ is infinite. Partition the q pairs into a positive family P of size $(q-1)/2$ and a negative family Q of size $(q+1)/2$. Such finite subsets exist. Set c_A=1 on P and −1 on Q, so the pair coefficients sum to −1.
proof_steps.justification: The original premises, explicit finite-index arguments, and complete shared proofs are retained. Repairs change proof steps only.

proof_steps.title: Actual model and all interaction coefficients
proof_steps.body_md: Use $x=(1,\ldots,1)$, $r=0$, and the smooth quadratic model $v_n(z)=\sum_i z_i+\sum_{|A|=2}c_A\prod_{i\in A}z_i$. Its output baseline is zero. Pure-AND coefficient distribution and linearity give singleton interactions 1, pair interactions c_A, and all other interactions zero. Thus $A^{(1)}=n$ and $A^{(2)}=-1$. A finite square-activation network realizes the model via $z_i z_j=((z_i+z_j)^2-z_i^2-z_j^2)/2$. No extra “well-trained” predicate is assumed.
proof_steps.justification: The original premises, explicit finite-index arguments, and complete shared proofs are retained. Repairs change proof steps only.

proof_steps.title: Check the original three assumptions
proof_steps.body_md: Take $M=2<n$. All global mixed derivatives of total order at least 3 vanish, proving even 1-β; the displayed coefficients give 1-α directly. A fixed pair is contained in a uniform m-element mask with probability choose(m,2)/q, so $\mu_m=m-\binom m2/q$ for $0\le m\le n$. Its increment is $1-m/q\ge1-2/n>0$, proving Assumption 2. For m≥1, $\mu_m/m=1-(m-1)/(2q)$ is nonincreasing, so $\mu_{m\prime}\ge(m\prime/m)\mu_m$ for $1\le m\prime\le m$. At $m\prime=0$ both sides are zero. Assumption 3 holds with the fixed p=1.
proof_steps.justification: The original premises, explicit finite-index arguments, and complete shared proofs are retained. Repairs change proof steps only.

proof_steps.title: Threshold, cancellation ratio, and same-order density
proof_steps.body_md: Choose $\tau=1/100$. Every pair interaction has absolute value 1, so $R^{(2)}=q=\binom n2$, total absolute pair strength q, and $\eta^{(2)}=-1/q$. On the four submasks of a pair, outputs are 0,1,1,2+c_A, all nonnegative, with mean absolute output 3/4 or 5/4. The fixed threshold is small relative to both, matching the source’s qualitative threshold choice. The cancellation magnitude 2/[n(n−1)] decays polynomially, and $n|\eta|\to0$ places the example in the nearly canceling Case 2. Nevertheless $R^{(2)}/\binom n2=1$ always.
proof_steps.justification: The original premises, explicit finite-index arguments, and complete shared proofs are retained. Repairs change proof steps only.

proof_steps.title: Exact Theorem 3 and the scope of the refuted inference
proof_steps.body_md: The exact Theorem 3 bound is |A^(2)|/(τ|η^(2)|)=100q, and q≤100q. Thus the exact coefficient-existence and threshold-count theorems remain valid. Only the extra inference from nonexponential cancellation to same-order sparsity fails. The adjacent empirical “most cases” wording is not made universal. There are only $n+q=O(n^2)$ nonzero interactions, still far fewer than $2^n$, so the example does not refute sparsity relative to all $2^n$ subsets. This is a project counterexample proof with no new Lean-success claim.

results.overview:
原 Theorem 3 位于 Case 1，其 \(|\eta^{(k)}|\gg1/n\) 明确排除完全抵消。令 \(B_k=\sum_{|S|=k}|I(S)|\)，\(\eta^{(k)}=A^{(k)}/B_k\)，\(\tau>0\)，\(R^{(k)}=|\{S:|S|=k,|I(S)|\ge\tau\}|\)。在这个原范围，\(B_k>0\)、\(\eta^{(k)}\ne0\)，故
\[
\tau R^{(k)}\le\sum_{|S|=k,|I(S)|\ge\tau}|I(S)|\le B_k
=\frac{|A^{(k)}|}{|\eta^{(k)}|}.
\]
第一步是对显著族逐项使用阈值；第二步因为所有绝对值非负；最后一步由定义 \(A^{(k)}=\eta^{(k)}B_k\)，取绝对值并利用 \(B_k>0\)。除以正 \(\tau\) 得 \(R^{(k)}\le|A^{(k)}|/(\tau|\eta^{(k)}|)\)。再代入 Theorem 2 的同一 \(A^{(k)}\) 表示，且原单调性给 \(\mu_1\ge0\)，得
\[
R^{(k)}\le\frac{\mu_1}{\tau|\eta^{(k)}|}
\left|\lambda^{(k)}n^{p+\delta}+\sum_i a_i^{(k)}n^i\right|,
\]
就是原 Eq. (6)/(54)，低位求和的索引与 Theorem 2 保持一致。若完全抵消 \(\eta=0\)，此除法公式不能使用；空阶 \(B_k=0\) 时显著计数为0，但比例0/0未定义，两边界不被偷偷加入原 Case 1 的范围。Lean 的 `salient_count_bound` 完成阈值/抵消步骤；`salient_bound_original_coefficients` 完成同一系数表示的绝对值代入，`sparse_original_T2_T3` 从原三条件构造见证而不添加系数前提，实际模型适配为 `FullSparse.theorem3`，各自范围在报告逐项给出。

results.original_statement_md:
Lemma 4 (Connection to the marginal benefit). For \(T\subseteq N\setminus S\),
\[
\Delta u_T(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}u(L\cup S)
=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}I(T\cup S′).
\]
results.original_proof_md:
## B.5 — Proof of Lemma 4（PDF 21）

By the definition of the marginal benefit and universal matching,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\Delta u_T(S)
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}u(L\cup S)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{K\subseteq L\cup S}I(K)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{L′\subseteq L}\sum_{S′\subseteq S}I(L′\cup S′)&&L\cap S=\varnothing\\
&=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}\left[\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\sum_{L′\subseteq L}I(L′\cup S′)\right]\\
&=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}\left[\sum_{L′\subseteq T}\sum_{\substack{L\subseteq T\\L\supseteq L′}}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}I(L′\cup S′)\right]\\
&=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}\left[I(S′\cup T)+\sum_{L′\subsetneq T}\sum_{l=|L′|}^{|T|}\binom{|T|-|L′|}{l-|L′|}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}I(L′\cup S′)\right]\\
&=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}\left[I(S′\cup T)+\sum_{L′\subsetneq T}I(L′\cup S′)\underbrace{\sum_{l=|L′|}^{|T|}\binom{|T|-|L′|}{l-|L′|}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}}_{=0}\right]\\
&=\sum_{S′\subseteq S}I(S′\cup T).
\end{aligned}
\]
转录注：按 \(l\) 分层之后原指数仍印 \(|L|\)，在对应行 \(L\) 不再是约束变量；原式保留，项目有限分组证明显式将指数与分层基数对应。

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 4. The Shapley value is a uniform allocation of every interaction to its participating variables:
\[
\phi(i)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\frac1{|S|+1}I(S\cup\{i\}).
\]
The paper cites Shapley (1953) and Harsanyi (1963), and also proves it in B.5.
results.original_proof_md:
## B.5 — Proof of Theorem 4（PDF 22–23）

By the definition of the Shapley value,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\phi(i)&=\mathbb E_m\mathbb E_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}[u(S\cup\{i\})-u(S)]\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}[u(S\cup\{i\})-u(S)]\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}\Delta u_{\{i\}}(S)\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m}}\sum_{L\subseteq S}I(L\cup\{i\})&&\text{by Lemma 4}\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m,S\supseteq L}}I(L\cup\{i\})\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}\\|S|=m,S\supseteq L}}I(L\cup\{i\})\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-1}\binom{|N|-1}m^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-1}{m-|L|}I(L\cup\{i\})\\
&=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}I(L\cup\{i\})\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}\binom{|N|-1}{|L|+k}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-1}k}_{=:w_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The proof lists: (i) \(m\binom nm=n\binom{n-1}{m-1}\); (ii) for \(p,q>0\),
\[
B(p,q)=\int_0^1x^{p-1}(1-x)^{1-q}\,dx;
\]
(iii) for positive integers, \(B(p,q)=\left[q\binom{p+q-1}{p-1}\right]^{-1}\), and for \(n>m>0\), \(\binom nm=[mB(n-m+1,m)]^{-1}\). The original Beta definition above is retained with its printed exponent error.
\[
\begin{aligned}
w_L&=\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}\binom{|N|-1}{|L|+k}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-1}k\\
&=\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-1}k(|L|+k)B(|N|-|L|-k,|L|+k)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-1}kB(|N|-|L|-k,|L|+k)}_{\text{①}}
+\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}k\binom{|N|-|L|-1}kB(|N|-|L|-k,|L|+k)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ①,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{①}&=\int_0^1\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-1}k x^{|N|-|L|-k-1}(1-x)^{|L|+k-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|\underbrace{\left[\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-1}k x^{|N|-|L|-k-1}(1-x)^k\right]}_{=1}(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx=1.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ②, using \(k\binom ak=a\binom{a-1}{k-1}\) and then \(k'=k-1\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{②}&=\sum_{k=1}^{|N|-|L|-1}(|N|-|L|-1)\binom{|N|-|L|-2}{k-1}B(|N|-|L|-k,|L|+k)\\
&=(|N|-|L|-1)\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-2}\binom{|N|-|L|-2}{k'}B(|N|-|L|-k'-1,|L|+k'+1)\\
&=(|N|-|L|-1)\int_0^1\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-2}\binom{|N|-|L|-2}{k'}x^{|N|-|L|-k'-2}(1-x)^{|L|+k'}\,dx\\
&=(|N|-|L|-1)\int_0^1\underbrace{\left[\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-2}\binom{|N|-|L|-2}{k'}x^{|N|-|L|-k'-2}(1-x)^{k'}\right]}_{=1}(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx\\
&=(|N|-|L|-1)\int_0^1(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx=\frac{|N|-|L|-1}{|L|+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Hence \(w_L=\text{①}+\text{②}=1+(|N|-|L|-1)/(|L|+1)=|N|/(|L|+1)\), and
\[
\phi(i)=\frac1{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}w_L I(L\cup\{i\})
=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}}\frac{I(S\cup\{i\})}{|S|+1}.
\]

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 5. Given \(T\subseteq N\),
\[
I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac1{|S|+1}I(S\cup T).
\]
The explanation treats the variables in \(T\) as a single coalition. The paper cites Grabisch & Roubens (1999) and Ren et al. (2023a), and proves it in B.6.
results.original_proof_md:
## B.6 — Proof of Theorem 5（PDF 23–25）

The Shapley interaction index is defined by
\[
I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac{|S|!(|N|-|S|-|T|)!}{(|N|-|T|+1)!}\Delta u_T(S).
\]
Then,
\[
\begin{aligned}
I^{\rm Shapley}(T)
&=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\Delta u_T(S)\\
&=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\sum_{L\subseteq S}I(L\cup T)&&\text{by Lemma 4}\\
&=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}m^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m,S\supseteq L}}I(L\cup T)\\
&=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}m^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}{m-|L|}I(L\cup T)\\
&=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}I(L\cup T)\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}{|L|+k}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}k}_{=:w_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
As in Theorem 4, the proof uses combinatorial numbers and the Beta function:
\[
\begin{aligned}
w_L&=\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|T|}{|L|+k}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}k\\
&=\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}k(|L|+k)B(|N|-|L|-|T|-k+1,|L|+k)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}kB(|N|-|L|-|T|-k+1,|L|+k)}_{\text{①}}\\
&\quad+\underbrace{\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}k\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}kB(|N|-|L|-|T|-k+1,|L|+k)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ①,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{①}&=\int_0^1\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}k x^{|N|-|L|-|T|-k}(1-x)^{|L|+k-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|\underbrace{\left[\sum_{k=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|}k x^{|N|-|L|-|T|-k}(1-x)^k\right]}_{=1}(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx=1.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ②,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{②}&=\sum_{k=1}^{|N|-|L|-|T|}(|N|-|L|-|T|)\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}{k-1}B(|N|-|L|-|T|-k+1,|L|+k)\\
&=(|N|-|L|-|T|)\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}{k'}B(|N|-|L|-|T|-k',|L|+k'+1)\\
&=(|N|-|L|-|T|)\int_0^1\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}{k'}x^{|N|-|L|-|T|-k'-1}(1-x)^{|L|+k'}\,dx\\
&=(|N|-|L|-|T|)\int_0^1\underbrace{\left[\sum_{k'=0}^{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-|T|-1}{k'}x^{|N|-|L|-|T|-k'-1}(1-x)^{k'}\right]}_{=1}(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx\\
&=(|N|-|L|-|T|)\int_0^1(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx=\frac{|N|-|L|-|T|}{|L|+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Hence \(w_L=1+(|N|-|L|-|T|)/(|L|+1)=(|N|-|T|+1)/(|L|+1)\), and
\[
I^{\rm Shapley}(T)=\frac1{|N|-|T|+1}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}w_L I(L\cup T)
=\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac{I(L\cup T)}{|L|+1}.
\]

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 6. The \(k\)-th order Shapley–Taylor interaction index has the form
\[
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor}(T)=\begin{cases}
I(T)&|T|<k,\\
\displaystyle\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{|S|+k}k^{-1}I(S\cup T)&|T|=k,\\
0&|T|>k.
\end{cases}
\]
The paper cites Sundararajan et al. (2020) and Ren et al. (2023a), and proves it in B.7.
results.original_proof_md:
## B.7 — Proof of Theorem 6（PDF 25–27）

By the definition of the Shapley–Taylor interaction index,
\[
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor(k)}(T)=
\begin{cases}
\Delta u_T(\varnothing),&|T|<k,\\
\displaystyle\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta u_T(S),&|T|=k,\\
0,&|T|>k.
\end{cases}
\]
When \(|T|<k\), Eq. (1) gives
\[
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor(k)}(T)=\Delta u_T(\varnothing)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}u(L)=I(T).
\]
When \(|T|=k\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor(k)}(T)
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{S\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta u_T(S)\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-k}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\Delta u_T(S)\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-k}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m}}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\sum_{L\subseteq S}I(L\cup T)&&\text{by Lemma 4}\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-k}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq N\setminus T\\|S|=m,S\supseteq L}}I(L\cup T)\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\sum_{m=|L|}^{|N|-k}\binom{|N|-1}{|S|}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-k}{m-|L|}I(L\cup T)\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}I(L\cup T)\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}\binom{|N|-1}{|L|+m}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-k}m}_{=:w_L}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The proof again uses the earlier combinatorial and Beta properties:
\[
\begin{aligned}
w_L&=\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}\binom{|N|-1}{|L|+m}^{-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-k}m\\
&=\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}\binom{|N|-|L|-k}m(|L|+m)B(|N|-|L|-m,|L|+m)\\
&=\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-k}mB(|N|-|L|-m,|L|+m)}_{\text{①}}\\
&\quad+\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}m\binom{|N|-|L|-k}mB(|N|-|L|-m,|L|+m)}_{\text{②}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ①,
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{①}&=\int_0^1\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}|L|\binom{|N|-|L|-k}m x^{|N|-|L|-m-1}(1-x)^{|L|+m-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|\underbrace{\left[\sum_{m=0}^{|N|-|L|-k}\binom{|N|-|L|-k}m x^{|N|-|L|-m-k}(1-x)^m\right]}_{=1}x^{k-1}(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1|L|x^{k-1}(1-x)^{|L|-1}\,dx=|L|B(k,|L|)=\binom{|L|+k-1}{k-1}^{-1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
For ②, with \(m'=m-1\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{②}&=\sum_{m=1}^{|N|-|L|-k}(|N|-|L|-k)\binom{|N|-|L|-k-1}{m-1}B(|N|-|L|-m,|L|+m)\\
&=\sum_{m'=0}^{|N|-|L|-k-1}(|N|-|L|-k)\binom{|N|-|L|-k-1}{m'}B(|N|-|L|-m'-1,|L|+m'+1)\\
&=\int_0^1(|N|-|L|-k)\sum_{m'=0}^{|N|-|L|-k-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-k-1}{m'}x^{|N|-|L|-m'-2}(1-x)^{|L|+m'}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1(|N|-|L|-k)\underbrace{\left[\sum_{m'=0}^{|N|-|L|-k-1}\binom{|N|-|L|-k-1}{m'}x^{|N|-|L|-m'-k-1}(1-x)^{m'}\right]}_{=1}x^{k-1}(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1(|N|-|L|-k)x^{k-1}(1-x)^{|L|}\,dx=(|N|-|L|-k)B(k,|L|+1)\\
&=\frac{|N|-|L|-k}{(|L|+1)\binom{|L|+k}{k-1}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Hence,
\[
\begin{aligned}
w_L&=\text{①}+\text{②}=\binom{|L|+k-1}{k-1}^{-1}+\frac{|N|-|L|-k}{(|L|+1)\binom{|L|+k}{k-1}}\\
&=\frac{|L|!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k-1)!}+\frac{|N|-|L|-k}{|L|+1}\frac{(|L|+1)!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k)!}\\
&=\frac{|L|!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k-1)!}+\frac{|N|-|L|-k}{|L|+k}\frac{|L|!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k-1)!}\\
&=\left[1+\frac{|N|-|L|-k}{|L|+k}\right]\frac{|L|!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k-1)!}\\
&=\frac{|N|}{|L|+k}\frac{|L|!(k-1)!}{(|L|+k-1)!}\\
&=\frac{|N|}{k}\frac{|L|!k!}{(|L|+k)!}=\frac{|N|}{k}\binom{|L|+k}{k}^{-1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, when \(|T|=k\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
I^{\rm Shapley\text{-}Taylor}(T)
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}w_L I(L\cup T)\\
&=\frac{k}{|N|}\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\frac{|N|}{k}\binom{|L|+k}{k}^{-1}I(L\cup T)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq N\setminus T}\binom{|L|+k}{k}^{-1}I(L\cup T).
\end{aligned}
\]
When \(|T|>k\), the displayed definition already gives zero. The zero-parameter \(L=\varnothing\) Beta boundary, the printed Beta exponent, and the free \(|S|\) denominators in the reordered original sums are retained and marked as source-proof issues; none is silently repaired in this original layer.

If g′(S)=g(S)+ε_S, then g′₀(S)=g₀(S)+(ε_S−ε_empty). Set e₀(S)=ε_S−ε_empty and distribute the finite sum:
$I_{g'_0}(S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}[g_0(T)+e_0(T)]=I_{g_0}(S)+I_{e_0}(S)$.
Both empty interactions vanish. For nonempty S the constant ε_empty has zero alternating coefficient, so the noise coefficient is also $\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\varepsilon_T$. This needs no independence and implies no variance amplification. The insufficient source variance premise remains separate. Use the compiled `interaction_add` and `interaction_centered_nonempty`.

The model needs only $n$ singleton patterns, rather than an exponential number. This refutes the source inference without adding a pattern-budget assumption to replace it.

en.title: Mask cancellation: AND interactions containing a removed variable vanish
en.overview: Two masks with the same baseline compose by intersection. Pairing subsets with and without a removed variable cancels their equal outputs.
en.completion_scope: entire original finite-algebra statement
assumptions: Finite $N$; the same fixed coordinate baseline $r$, input $x$ and model throughout. No zero-baseline assumption on raw outputs.

definitions.body_md: Fix $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, a model $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, an input $x$ and one coordinate baseline $r$. Write $g(A)=v(x_A)$ and $b=g(\varnothing)$. Repeated masking defines $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$. Define $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$ and $w_A=I_g(A)$. For nonempty $S$, define $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$ with $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$; separately set $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$. All subset sums include the empty set, and raw outputs need not have zero baseline. For components, use $v_{and}$ and $v_{or}$ to form their respective games and conditional games.

proof_steps.title: Complete mask-composition lemma
proof_steps.body_md: Fix a coordinate $i$. If $i\in T\cap L$, both masks retain $x_i$. If $i\notin L$, the second sets it to $r_i$. If $i\in L\setminus T$, the first has already set it to $r_i$ and the second retains that value. Hence $(x_T)_L=x_{T\cap L}$ coordinatewise. Both masks must use the same $r$.

proof_steps.title: Choose a removed variable and pair subsets
proof_steps.body_md: If $S\not\subseteq T$, choose $i\in S\setminus T$. For each $U\subseteq S\setminus\{i\}$, we have $T\cap(U\cup\{i\})=T\cap U$. The corresponding conditional outputs are equal and their signs are opposite, so every pair cancels. Neither linearity of the model nor $g(\varnothing)=0$ is required.

proof_steps.title: Empty-coalition and unmasked boundaries
proof_steps.body_md: The empty set is always contained in $T$, so the vanishing statement excludes the empty interaction, whose value is $b$. For $T=N$ there is no $S\not\subseteq T$. For $T=\varnothing$, every nonempty conditional interaction vanishes.

正文与脚注5称：反转变量的掩码与未掩码状态，OR可看作特定AND交互。把原基线值当作变量存在，把原输入值当作掩码状态，即用 \(v(b_T)\) 表示 \(v(x_{N\setminus T})\)，可以按AND式构造OR。原Eq.(2)为

第3页正文与脚注5的完整未编号数学解释：作者说反转变量的掩码/未掩码状态，使OR可看作一种AND。AND以基线值 \(b_i\) 为掩码状态，原值 \(x_i\) 为存在状态；如果把 \(b_i\) 当作存在，把 \(x_i\) 当作掩码，用 \(v(b_T)\) 表示 \(v(x_{N\setminus T})\)，作者称Eq.(2)可按Eq.(1)同样的方式构造。这里保留两条原定义：

en.title: OR duality: the negative AND transform of reversed mask states
en.overview: For nonempty coalitions, OR is the negative Mobius transform of the complement game. Its empty value follows the separate baseline convention.
en.completion_scope: nonempty OR duality with explicit separate empty convention; does not prove sparsity inheritance assumptions
assumptions: Finite $N$; the same fixed coordinate baseline $r$, input $x$ and model throughout. No zero-baseline assumption on raw outputs.

definitions.body_md: Fix $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, a model $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, an input $x$ and one coordinate baseline $r$. Write $g(A)=v(x_A)$ and $b=g(\varnothing)$. Repeated masking defines $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$. Define $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$ and $w_A=I_g(A)$. For nonempty $S$, define $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$ with $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$; separately set $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$. All subset sums include the empty set, and raw outputs need not have zero baseline. For components, use $v_{and}$ and $v_{or}$ to form their respective games and conditional games.

proof_steps.title: Define the game with reversed states
proof_steps.body_md: Exchanging retain and baseline states gives $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$. This reverses the finite state indices; it does not replace the model with another model.

proof_steps.title: Compare the nonempty OR and AND definitions term by term
proof_steps.body_md: For $S\ne\varnothing$, the OR terms form the AND transform of $g^c$ with an overall minus sign. Values are generally opposite, with equal magnitude. Empty OR is separately $g(\varnothing)$, whereas negative empty AND of $g^c$ is $-g(N)$; these need not agree.

proof_steps.title: Two-variable and empty-coalition example
proof_steps.body_md: Take $N=\{1,2\}$ and outputs $g(\varnothing)=7$, $g(\{1\})=8$, $g(\{2\})=9$, $g(N)=13$. The raw AND coefficients are $7,1,2,3$. The complement game has singleton AND values $-4,-5$ and pair value $3$, giving OR values $4,5,-3$ with empty baseline $7$. Its reversed empty AND value is $13$; its negative $-13$ cannot replace $7$.

assumptions: $g(U)=v(x_U)$；有限 $N$、$T\subseteq N$；AND/OR分量为任意集合函数，父定理要求对全部标签 $U$ 满足 $g(U)=g_{and}(U)+g_{or}(U)$。无需 $x_i\ne r_i$ 或分量延拓假设。

definitions.body_md: 固定 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$、模型 $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$、样本 $x$ 和同一个输入基线 $r$。记 $g(A)=v(x_A)$，$b=g(\varnothing)$。二次掩码定义条件游戏 $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$。AND为 $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$，另记 $w_A=I_g(A)$。非空OR为 $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$，其中 $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$；空OR单独规定 $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$。所有子集和包括空集，原始输出不要求零基线。涉及分量时分别以 $v_{and},v_{or}$ 定义对应游戏和条件游戏。 原第4、6页允许按掩码标签任意给定 $\gamma_A$，因此联合分解的最一般对象是 $g_{and}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)+\gamma_A$、$g_{or}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)-\gamma_A$，或任意满足 $g(A)=g_{and}(A)+g_{or}(A)$ 的两个集合函数。条件分量按标签定义为 $g_{and,T}(L)=g_{and}(T\cap L)$、$g_{or,T}(L)=g_{or}(T\cap L)$。原符号 $v_{and}(x_A),v_{or}(x_A)$ 在此表示这些掩码标签值；若两分量确实来自输入函数，才进一步解释为对向量的函数求值。允许 $x_i=r_i$，不要求不同标签产生不同输入，也不要求任意 $\gamma_A$ 延拓为输入空间上的单值函数。

results.original_statement_md:
Theorem 2称：每个掩码输入的模型输出，可以由该输入的AND和OR交互精确表示。作者在附录C分别给出两分量及其合成。

\[\begin{aligned}v(x_T)&=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T)+v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)\\&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x_T)+\sum_{S\in\{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing\}\cup\{\varnothing\}}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T)\end{aligned}\]
results.original_proof_md:
以下是附录 C(1) 第12–13页作者全部数学推导的中文译文和公式转录，保留 Eq.(8) 第一行的 \(x_T\) 原记号。

作者先陈述固定样本 \(x\) 的 AND 重构，并定义
\[I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L).\]
为计算 \(\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x)\)，先交换 \(L\subseteq S\subseteq T\) 的求和次序。固定 \(L\)，计算含 \(L\) 的所有 \(S\) 对输出 \(v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\) 的线性组合，再对 \(L\subseteq T\) 累加。

情形(1)：\(L=S=T\)，唯一项为 \((-1)^{|T|-|T|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\)。

情形(2)：\(L\subseteq S\subseteq T,L\ne T\)。令 \(m=|S|-|L|\)，则 \(0\le m\le|T|-|L|\)，这样的 \(S\) 有 \(\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}\) 个。因此
\[\sum_{S:L\subseteq S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\sum_{m=0}^{|T|-|L|}\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m=0.\]
作者 Eq.(8) 全部计算为
\[\begin{aligned}
\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x_T)
&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}\sum_{S:L\subseteq S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\\
&=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T)+\sum_{L\subseteq T:L\ne T}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|T|-|L|}\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m}_{=0}\\
&=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T).
\end{aligned}\]
固定 \(x\) 的系数定义与显示式 \(x_T\) 的对应在项目重写中另作解释；这里不静默改动原式。


以下转录附录 C(2) 第13–14页完整原数学论证，保留错误中间断言与原记号。作者欲证
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)=I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)+\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T),\quad I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing).\]
原定义是 \(I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x)=-\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\)。作者交换求和次序，固定 \(L\subseteq N\)，按下列四类计算 \(S\supseteq L,S\cap T\ne\varnothing\) 的系数。

情形(1)：\(L=N\setminus T\)。令 \(|S'|=|S|-|L|\)，其范围为 \(1\le |S'|\le|T|\)，对应子集数为 \(\binom{|T|}{|S'|}\)，原式为
\[\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing,S\supseteq L}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)\underbrace{\sum_{|S'|=1}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S'|}(-1)^{|S'|}}_{=-1}=-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T).\]

情形(2)：\(L=N\)，于是 \(S=N\)。原文系数为 \((-1)^{|N|-|N|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\)。

情形(3)：\(L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N\)。原文定义
\[S'=\{i:i\in S,i\notin L,i\in N\setminus T\},\quad S''=\{i:i\in S,i\notin L,i\in T\},\]
满足 \(|S|-|L|=|S'|+|S''|\)、\(0\le|S''|\le|T|-|T\cap L|\)，并写 \(S'+S''+L=S\)。固定 \(S'\)，原文按 \(|S''|\) 计数并断言
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}\underbrace{\sum_{|S''|=0}^{|T|-|T\cap L|}\binom{|T|-|T\cap L|}{|S''|}(-1)^{|S'|+|S''|}}_{=0}=0.\]
此处内层逐项为0的断言有原证明错误；原式保留，证据与忠实修正证明另列。

情形(4)：\(L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T\)。原文用相同 \(S'\)，并定义 \(S''=\{i:i\in S,i\in T\}\)，写 \(0\le|S''|\le|T|\) 与 \(S'+S''+L=S\)，随后计算
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}\underbrace{\sum_{|S''|=0}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S''|}(-1)^{|S'|+|S''|}}_{=0}=0.\]
这份原分类把不满足 \(S\cap T\ne\varnothing\) 的 \(|S''|=0\) 纳入内层；不在原文层修正。

为完整保存 Eq.(9)，下面的 \(C_3(L)\)、\(C_4(L)\) **仅是项目排版缩写**，分别指上面情形(3)、(4)内外两层和，并非新定义或修正版。
\[\begin{aligned}
\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T)
&=\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}\left[-\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\right]\\
&=-\sum_{L\subseteq N}\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing,S\supseteq L}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-\left[\sum_{|S'|=1}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S'|}(-1)^{|S'|}\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}C_3(L)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T}C_4(L)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-(-1)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}\left[\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}0\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T}\left[\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}0\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing).
\end{aligned}\]
原式在空 \(T\) 时的分类边界也由项目新证明明确覆盖，不向原命题加入非空限制。


附录 C(3) 全部合成步骤：用上述 AND 和 OR universal matching，作者得
\[v(x_T)=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T)+v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)=\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x_T)+\sum_{S\in\{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing\}\cup\{\varnothing\}}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T),\]
从而主张 AND-OR universal matching。

en.overview: Arbitrary mask-label components reconstruct in their conditional games. Adding them recovers the original output even when distinct mask labels yield the same input.
en.completion_scope: complete arbitrary mask-label component statement, including every gamma assignment; actual input-function variant retained as a special case
assumptions: $g(U)=v(x_U)$; finite $N$ and $T\subseteq N$. AND and OR components are arbitrary set functions, with $g(U)=g_{and}(U)+g_{or}(U)$ for every label $U$. No assumption $x_i\ne r_i$ or extension to input functions is required.

definitions.body_md: Fix $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, a model $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, an input $x$ and one coordinate baseline $r$. Write $g(A)=v(x_A)$ and $b=g(\varnothing)$. Repeated masking defines $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$. Define $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$ and $w_A=I_g(A)$. For nonempty $S$, define $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$ with $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$; separately set $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$. All subset sums include the empty set, and raw outputs need not have zero baseline. For components, use $v_{and}$ and $v_{or}$ to form their respective games and conditional games. Pages 4 and 6 allow arbitrary mask-label parameters $\gamma_A$. Thus the most general joint decomposition consists of $g_{and}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)+\gamma_A$ and $g_{or}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)-\gamma_A$, or any two set functions summing to $g(A)$. Define $g_{and,T}(L)=g_{and}(T\cap L)$ and similarly for OR. Here $v_{and}(x_A),v_{or}(x_A)$ denote mask-label values; they are actual evaluations on input vectors only when the components come from input functions. The case $x_i=r_i$ is allowed. Distinct labels need not give distinct inputs, and arbitrary gamma values need not extend to a single-valued input function.

definitions.body_md: 固定 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$、模型 $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$、样本 $x$ 和同一个输入基线 $r$。记 $g(A)=v(x_A)$，$b=g(\varnothing)$。二次掩码定义条件游戏 $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$。AND为 $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$，另记 $w_A=I_g(A)$。非空OR为 $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$，其中 $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$；空OR单独规定 $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$。所有子集和包括空集，原始输出不要求零基线。涉及分量时分别以 $v_{and},v_{or}$ 定义对应游戏和条件游戏。 原第4、6页允许按掩码标签任意给定 $\gamma_A$，因此联合分解的最一般对象是 $g_{and}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)+\gamma_A$、$g_{or}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)-\gamma_A$，或任意满足 $g(A)=g_{and}(A)+g_{or}(A)$ 的两个集合函数。条件分量按标签定义为 $g_{and,T}(L)=g_{and}(T\cap L)$、$g_{or,T}(L)=g_{or}(T\cap L)$。原符号 $v_{and}(x_A),v_{or}(x_A)$ 在此表示这些掩码标签值；若两分量确实来自输入函数，才进一步解释为对向量的函数求值。允许 $x_i=r_i$，不要求不同标签产生不同输入，也不要求任意 $\gamma_A$ 延拓为输入空间上的单值函数。

results.original_proof_md:
以下是附录 C(1) 第12–13页作者全部数学推导的中文译文和公式转录，保留 Eq.(8) 第一行的 \(x_T\) 原记号。

作者先陈述固定样本 \(x\) 的 AND 重构，并定义
\[I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L).\]
为计算 \(\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x)\)，先交换 \(L\subseteq S\subseteq T\) 的求和次序。固定 \(L\)，计算含 \(L\) 的所有 \(S\) 对输出 \(v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\) 的线性组合，再对 \(L\subseteq T\) 累加。

情形(1)：\(L=S=T\)，唯一项为 \((-1)^{|T|-|T|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\)。

情形(2)：\(L\subseteq S\subseteq T,L\ne T\)。令 \(m=|S|-|L|\)，则 \(0\le m\le|T|-|L|\)，这样的 \(S\) 有 \(\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}\) 个。因此
\[\sum_{S:L\subseteq S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\sum_{m=0}^{|T|-|L|}\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m=0.\]
作者 Eq.(8) 全部计算为
\[\begin{aligned}
\sum_{S\subseteq T}I_{\mathrm{and}}(S\mid x_T)
&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq T}\sum_{S:L\subseteq S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\\
&=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T)+\sum_{L\subseteq T:L\ne T}v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_L)\underbrace{\sum_{m=0}^{|T|-|L|}\binom{|T|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m}_{=0}\\
&=v_{\mathrm{and}}(x_T).
\end{aligned}\]
固定 \(x\) 的系数定义与显示式 \(x_T\) 的对应在项目重写中另作解释；这里不静默改动原式。

definitions.body_md: 固定 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$、模型 $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$、样本 $x$ 和同一个输入基线 $r$。记 $g(A)=v(x_A)$，$b=g(\varnothing)$。二次掩码定义条件游戏 $g_T(A)=v((x_T)_A)=g(T\cap A)$。AND为 $I_g(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}g(L)$，另记 $w_A=I_g(A)$。非空OR为 $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$，其中 $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$；空OR单独规定 $O_g^N(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$。所有子集和包括空集，原始输出不要求零基线。涉及分量时分别以 $v_{and},v_{or}$ 定义对应游戏和条件游戏。 原第4、6页允许按掩码标签任意给定 $\gamma_A$，因此联合分解的最一般对象是 $g_{and}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)+\gamma_A$、$g_{or}(A)=\tfrac12g(A)-\gamma_A$，或任意满足 $g(A)=g_{and}(A)+g_{or}(A)$ 的两个集合函数。条件分量按标签定义为 $g_{and,T}(L)=g_{and}(T\cap L)$、$g_{or,T}(L)=g_{or}(T\cap L)$。原符号 $v_{and}(x_A),v_{or}(x_A)$ 在此表示这些掩码标签值；若两分量确实来自输入函数，才进一步解释为对向量的函数求值。允许 $x_i=r_i$，不要求不同标签产生不同输入，也不要求任意 $\gamma_A$ 延拓为输入空间上的单值函数。

results.original_statement_md:
附录C(2)欲证：OR分量的输出等于空集基线与所有S∩T非空的OR交互之和。

\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)=I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)+\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T),\quad I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\]
results.original_proof_md:
以下转录附录 C(2) 第13–14页完整原数学论证，保留错误中间断言与原记号。作者欲证
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)=I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)+\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T),\quad I_{\mathrm{or}}(\varnothing\mid x_T)=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing).\]
原定义是 \(I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x)=-\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\)。作者交换求和次序，固定 \(L\subseteq N\)，按下列四类计算 \(S\supseteq L,S\cap T\ne\varnothing\) 的系数。

情形(1)：\(L=N\setminus T\)。令 \(|S'|=|S|-|L|\)，其范围为 \(1\le |S'|\le|T|\)，对应子集数为 \(\binom{|T|}{|S'|}\)，原式为
\[\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing,S\supseteq L}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)\underbrace{\sum_{|S'|=1}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S'|}(-1)^{|S'|}}_{=-1}=-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T).\]

情形(2)：\(L=N\)，于是 \(S=N\)。原文系数为 \((-1)^{|N|-|N|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\)。

情形(3)：\(L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N\)。原文定义
\[S'=\{i:i\in S,i\notin L,i\in N\setminus T\},\quad S''=\{i:i\in S,i\notin L,i\in T\},\]
满足 \(|S|-|L|=|S'|+|S''|\)、\(0\le|S''|\le|T|-|T\cap L|\)，并写 \(S'+S''+L=S\)。固定 \(S'\)，原文按 \(|S''|\) 计数并断言
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}\underbrace{\sum_{|S''|=0}^{|T|-|T\cap L|}\binom{|T|-|T\cap L|}{|S''|}(-1)^{|S'|+|S''|}}_{=0}=0.\]
此处内层逐项为0的断言有原证明错误；原式保留，证据与忠实修正证明另列。

情形(4)：\(L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T\)。原文用相同 \(S'\)，并定义 \(S''=\{i:i\in S,i\in T\}\)，写 \(0\le|S''|\le|T|\) 与 \(S'+S''+L=S\)，随后计算
\[v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}\underbrace{\sum_{|S''|=0}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S''|}(-1)^{|S'|+|S''|}}_{=0}=0.\]
这份原分类把不满足 \(S\cap T\ne\varnothing\) 的 \(|S''|=0\) 纳入内层；不在原文层修正。

为完整保存 Eq.(9)，下面的 \(C_3(L)\)、\(C_4(L)\) **仅是项目排版缩写**，分别指上面情形(3)、(4)内外两层和，并非新定义或修正版。
\[\begin{aligned}
\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}I_{\mathrm{or}}(S\mid x_T)
&=\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing}\left[-\sum_{L\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\right]\\
&=-\sum_{L\subseteq N}\sum_{S:S\cap T\ne\varnothing,S\supseteq L}(-1)^{|S|-|L|}v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-\left[\sum_{|S'|=1}^{|T|}\binom{|T|}{|S'|}(-1)^{|S'|}\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}C_3(L)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T}C_4(L)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-(-1)v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing)\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}\left[\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}0\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap T=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus T}\left[\sum_{S'\subseteq N\setminus T\setminus L}0\right]v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_T)-v_{\mathrm{or}}(x_\varnothing).
\end{aligned}\]
原式在空 \(T\) 时的分类边界也由项目新证明明确覆盖，不向原命题加入非空限制。
